newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark remains little changed after Bundesbank.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark remains little changed after Bundesbank.

text.p: 1126 GMT - Mark mostly steady on crosses after Wednesday's sell-off, Bundesbank keeps official rates unchanged, sets next two repos at fixed unchanged 3.0 percent.
* Bundesbank decision in line with market expectations. Some vague speculation earlier about switch to variable repos.
* Mark regains some lost ground against Swedish crown in technical rebound after slide to below 4.27, lowest since December 1992.
* West German preliminary July CPI rises 0.5 pct m/m, up 1.8 pct y/y, slightly higher than expected.
* Bank of France's Trichet sticks with G7 consensus dollar has corrected previous imbalances.
* Mark/French franc at 3.3713/15 compared with 3.3706/11 in late European trading on Wednesday.
* Mark/Swiss at 81.26/32, little changed from 81.28/38 at previous close but above 81.04 low on Wednesday, the lowest since Aug 1996.
* Mark/Swedish crown firmer at 4.2870/80 vs 4.2805/35 late Wednesday after it fell to lowest since Dec 1992 at 4.2795 on Wednesday.
* Mark/lira at 972.40/70 vs 972.25/50. -- Astrid Zweynert London forex desk + 44 171 542 7792
